shortDescription: Mark Cabana, co-head of global rates research at BofA Global Research, said the front end of the global yield curve could reprice higher as central banks reduce accommodation, according to Bloomberg.He made the comments on the sidelines of the BofA APAC Conference in Hong Kong.

children: Mark Cabana, co-head of global rates research at BofA Global Research, said the front end of the global yield curve could reprice higher as central banks reduce accommodation, according to Bloomberg.
He made the comments on the sidelines of the BofA APAC Conference in Hong Kong.

title: BofA's Cabana Sees Front-End Yields Repricing Higher
